text: Toronto and East York Community Council will introduce bills.

General Bills Toronto and East York Community Council passed By-laws 435-2026 to 463-2026, subject to Section 226.9 of the City of Toronto Act, 2006. Confirmatory Bills Toronto and East York Community Council passed Confirmatory Bill as By-law 464-2026, subject to Section 226.9 of the City of Toronto Act, 2006.
